challenges.challenge: Prove the implementation branch starts from the exact accepted Activation binding commit/tree and contains no unrelated ancestry.
Attempt to invoke build/package/release on an unauthorized branch, dirty tree and evidence mode; all must fail closed.
Attempt to reuse WP1 PIPELINE_TEST_ONLY artifacts or a prior WP7 session under renamed paths; provenance checks must reject.
Attempt staging traversal, absolute paths, UNC paths, symlinks, NFC collisions and Windows case collisions.
Change a payload byte after inventory generation and prove payload and manifest sealing rejects it.
Alter one release identity consumer or retain credentialProtocolVersion 2; consistency gates must reject.
Run concurrent builds against the same staging/output and prove exclusive lease and cross-session isolation.
Crash at every K01-K15 point and prove no partial artifact can be promoted or reused.
Replace or modify the installer after sealing and immediately before execution; SHA256 controls must abort.
Leave one old executable, process, config, DB, cache, installer, staging file, shortcut, service, task or startup entry; cleanup evidence must fail.
Attempt first start with an old data root or legacy migration enabled; validation must fail.
Attempt to run two backend owners or bypass event-gap snapshot recovery in the installed runtime.
Attempt to produce final evidence from development fixtures, screenshots or a different installer SHA256; schema/identity joins must reject.
Replace complete source ZIP with changed-files-only content or prune WP6 ancestry from the bundle; closure checks must reject.
Remove or broaden any inherited risk acceptance; governance validation must reject.
Search all evidence for secrets, API session material, credential payloads and vault-derived digests; any hit blocks delivery.
Prove every mutation M01-M44 is killed by the named oracle with no harness-classification false pass.
Independently rebuild package inventories and SHA256 lists from scratch and compare exact results.
Verify Convergence Pre-Review package does not contain final installer or final acceptance claims.
Verify Final Packaging cannot run without WP7_PREACCEPTED_FOR_FINAL_PACKAGING and unchanged preaccepted source identity.
Delete or duplicate one A01-A10 mapping or change its test/evidence/oracle binding.
